dct_description_sm: The data set locates bridges as a point feature class. The locations for bridges in the data set match the location maps provided with the bridge inspection reports. Attributes from the bridge inspection reports including 2006 Bridge Sufficiency Rating (BSR) and from SHA average daily traffic counts (ADT) were appended to the feature class. ADT dates are primarily from 2003.
